name: OmniTools
description: 🛠️ OmniTools is a versatile all in one web application that offers a comprehensive collection of over 80 practical utilities designed to simplify everyday digital tasks. It acts as a Swiss Army knife for your browser enabling you to handle a wide range of file formats conversions and manipulations all without relying on external servers or cloud uploads.
short_desc: An all-in-one collection of powerful web-based tools for everyday tasks
author: Ibrahima Gaye Coulibaly
